name: 41626-burstprefill-397b-8gpudp
hardware: 8x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 of one a3 node (--gres=gpu:8), sm90, NVLink across all eight cards. Driver 570.195.03.
parallelism: DP=8, TP=1, PP=1, with expert parallelism over the same eight ranks: eight replicas, one per card, the 512 experts sharded 64 to a rank (~48 GB) and everything else replicated (~14 GB). One in-process front end, no external router, no proxy, no cache tier.
architecture: hybrid sparse-MoE decoder with a vision tower (Qwen3_5MoeForConditionalGeneration): 60 text layers of which 15 are full attention and 45 gated-delta-net linear attention, 512 routed experts at top-10 plus one shared expert, ~397B total and ~17B active, fp8 block-quantised weights, 379 GB on disk.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1024, bounded at 1024 requests with a 900 s safety cap, no warmup and no cooldown, static seed 41626. One wave: all 1024 arrive at t=0 and the pass ends when the last finishes, so streams and max_requests are one operating point and must move together.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets: exactly 4096 prompt tokens in and exactly 32 out (min == max on both), `ignore_eos: true`, `request_format: plain` so no chat template is applied. 4.19M prompt tokens in, 32768 out. Text only -- the vision tower is sent nothing.
purpose: A 397-billion-parameter document analysis assistant handling 1024 simultaneous long-prompt requests with brief replies on eight GPUs.
launch:
# Engine 24337fb860a89f2087df27b02b7c9620a7fd0093 (git describe --tags:
# v0.20.2rc0-354-g24337fb860a8), whose interpreter is named by configs/env.yaml.

model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8

data-parallel-size: 8
tensor-parallel-size: 1
enable-expert-parallel: true

max-num-batched-tokens: 4096
max-num-seqs: 32
max-model-len: 8192

# Must stay INLINE JSON on ONE line. The reader that hands this file to the engine skips indented
# lines, so as a block mapping this key reaches the engine as nothing at all: the startup synthetic
# multimodal encode then runs and reserves its peak, at rc=0. Quoting it fails too -- pydantic
# rejects a string.
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 0, "video": 0}

dtype: bfloat16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
